Topic Coverage

Topics We Cover

From classical mechanics to modern physics, every major topic taught at exam depth.

Mechanics

Newton's laws, SUVAT, momentum, energy, and circular motion taught structurally.

Electricity

Circuits, Ohm's law, capacitors, and electromagnetic induction explained with diagrams.

Waves & Optics

Wave equation, refraction, diffraction, and superposition taught with worked diagrams.

Thermal & Quantum

Kinetic theory, photoelectric effect, and de Broglie wavelength explained clearly.

Paper And Practical

From Paper To Lab

Physics exams need theory and practicals. We cover both with equal care.

Theory Paper Drills

Paper 1, 2, and 3 worked through with full mark scheme guidance.

Practical Paper Skills

Paper 5 and 6 practical skills built from data tables, graphs, and error analysis.

Past Paper Drills

Cambridge, Edexcel, and IB past papers worked weekly under timed conditions.

Exam Technique Drills

Definitions, unit consistency, and significant figures drilled until reflex.

Meet Our Tutors

Inside A Real Paper

Here is one Cambridge 0625 question, the common mistake, and what scores marks.

One Real Cambridge 0625 QuestionPaper 4 · 4 marks

"A 2.0 kg trolley moves at 3.0 m/s and collides with a stationary 4.0 kg trolley. They move together after the collision. Calculate the final velocity."

Common student mistake: Skipping the conservation of momentum statement.

What earns full marks: Equation written, masses substituted, working shown, units included.

How Ustaad teaches it: Diagram first, momentum equation second, arithmetic last.

Past paper guidance reviewed by Cambridge-trained physics tutors with examiner experience.
